name: 94538 · Fremont, CA
findings: ZIP 94538 (Fremont) has 226 nonprofit organizations. 82 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 65 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94538 (Fremont) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
